headline: Amyris buys sweet-protein start-up Oobli; Cargill bakery sugar cuts; FDA GRAS rule prep
summary: Amyris is acquiring California sweet-protein start-up Oobli to scale precision-fermented sweet proteins, creating a stronger potential partner for deep sugar reduction in Puratos fillings, creams and chocolate.
Cargill is pushing new sugar-reduction solutions into bakery, a direct competitive move against Puratos reformulation offerings that sales teams should benchmark.
A US start-up has launched a gluten-free cocoa extender, a cost-relief option Belcolade and fillings teams should evaluate amid high cocoa prices.
Regulatory: lawyers urge companies to prepare now for FDA's proposed end of self-affirmed GRAS, so Puratos should audit US ingredients that rely on it and plan notifications.
Danish start-up 21st.Bio has filed for EU approval of animal-free whey protein, a future dairy alternative for creams and fillings.

items.title: Food challenge winner launches gluten-free cocoa extender
items.summary: A US food-challenge winner has launched a gluten-free cocoa extender ingredient that partially replaces cocoa powder.
items.why: Cocoa extenders directly address cocoa cost pressure; Belcolade and fillings teams should evaluate it as a possible partner or competitor.

items.title: Oobli: US Sweet Protein Startup Acquired by Precision Fermentation Player Amyris
items.summary: US precision-fermentation firm Amyris has agreed to acquire Oobli, a California start-up making precision-fermented sweet proteins for sugar reduction; terms undisclosed.
items.why: Sweet proteins could enable deep sugar cuts in fillings, creams and chocolate; Amyris-Oobli scale-up makes a supply or co-development partnership more realistic.

items.title: Amyris to acquire Oobli in bid to scale sweet proteins for sugar reduction
items.summary: Amyris is acquiring sweet-protein start-up Oobli to scale precision-fermented sweet proteins for sugar reduction.
items.why: Same deal as the Green Queen report: a scaled sweet-protein supplier could be a partner for sugar-reduced fillings and chocolate.

items.title: Amyris to acquire sweet protein company Oobli
items.summary: Amyris will acquire Oobli, which makes fermentation-derived sweet proteins for sugar reduction.
items.why: Duplicate coverage of the Amyris-Oobli deal; potential sweet-protein supplier for sugar-reduced patisserie and chocolate.

items.title: Sourdough Bioactives from Fermentation to Human Physiology: Biosynthesis, Bioavailability, Mechanisms and Clinical Evidence
items.summary: Review of how sourdough fermentation generates bioactives (organic acids, phenolics, peptides, EPS, GABA) and the clinical evidence for their health effects.
items.why: Useful evidence base for health claims and positioning of Sapore sourdough products.

items.title: Cargill targets sugar reduction sweet spots with bakery and beverage innovations
items.summary: Cargill is promoting new sugar-reduction solutions targeting bakery and beverage applications.
items.why: Cargill is a direct competitor in sugar reduction for baked goods and sweet fillings; monitor its offering against Puratos reformulation solutions.

items.title: Helping Ghanian Cocoa Farmers Prove Properties are Deforestation-Free
items.summary: UConn researchers are helping Ghanaian cocoa farmers document that their farms are deforestation-free.
items.why: Farm-level deforestation proof supports EUDR compliance for Belcolade cocoa sourcing from Ghana.

items.title: Spray-Dried Microencapsulation of Endophytic Yeast Using Maltodextrin–Whey Protein to Enhance Dough Fermentation and Bread Quality
items.summary: Endophytic yeast was spray-dried in a maltodextrin-whey protein matrix to keep it viable and improve dough fermentation and bread quality.
items.why: Encapsulated alternative leavening strains are a technology to watch for yeast and fermentation-starter offerings.

items.title: News bites: Utz, Baker & Baker and Lantmännen Unibake in the M&A spotlight
items.summary: Bakery and snack M&A roundup: a proposed US$2.9bn take-private of Utz, Baker & Baker acquisitions in free-from and frozen bread, and a CMA-ordered UK plant sale by Lantmannen Unibake.
items.why: Consolidation among Puratos customers (frozen and free-from bread) can shift purchasing decisions; account teams should track the new owners.

items.title: FDA’s Proposed GRAS Rule: Why Companies Should Prepare Now
items.summary: Law firm commentary urges companies to prepare for FDA's proposed rule ending self-affirmed GRAS.
items.why: US ingredient launches by Puratos and its suppliers may need FDA notification; regulatory teams should audit self-affirmed GRAS ingredients and plan dossiers.

items.title: 21st.Bio Files for EU Approval of Animal-Free Whey Protein, Calls for Faster Regulation
items.summary: Danish start-up 21st.Bio has filed an EU application to sell precision-fermented beta-lactoglobulin (whey protein) and calls for a fast-track approval pathway.
items.why: Animal-free whey could replace dairy proteins in creams and fillings once EU approval lands; worth tracking as a future supplier.
